Hi Adrian,

Great talking with you. So here is everything I think we should do. 

Rather than just building a new website, we should build a lead-generation system that continues bringing in qualified leads month after month. - so even after dec season, it still brings leads (build a brand and be ranking in google and LLMs for 100s of keywords)

Here's what I have in mind:

A modern AI-powered website that's built for both Google and AI search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
Individual service pages targeting each of your core services.
A strategic city page strategy. Since you're willing to travel for the right clients, I'd focus on major corporate markets where the opportunity is greatest, such as:
Seattle
Portland
San Francisco
San Jose
Sacramento
Los Angeles
San Diego
Phoenix
Las Vegas
Denver
Dallas
and all cities you think are best (we can even go top 200 cities by population etc)
For each city, we'd build unique, high-quality location pages using a combination of AI and human editing. Rather than creating generic pages, each one would include:

Companies and organizations in that city that may hire entertainment.
Nearby airports.
Convention and conference centers.
Locally relevant keywords and content.
Frequently Asked Questions.
Structured data (Schema) to help search engines better understand the page.
Strong internal linking and AI-friendly optimization

For ongoing SEO we should do
AI-friendly optimization (schema, structured data, internal linking, and content) so the website starts coming up for dozens of keywords in all cities
Call tracking so we know exactly where your leads are coming from.
Ongoing content / video/ review additions and optimization so the website continues growing over time.
Solid backlinks 
Multiple review websites reviewing top 10 magicians and recommending you etc. 
 The goal is to create an online asset that consistently generates qualified leads and positions you as the go-to corporate magician and mentalist in the markets you want to serve.
